AdaptiveSource.description: Refinement surface derived from a solved attempt (adaptive mesh refinement).
AdaptiveSource.title: AdaptiveSource

Batch.description:
Several simulations from one base setup (AirShaper-style batch runs). Only whitelisted
paths can vary, so a batch can never write arbitrary configuration.
Batch.title: Batch

Convergence.description:
Force-history convergence detection and averaging (a stop condition when enabled).

`tolerance` bounds the fitted change of each normalised load across the last third of the
history (0.01 = 1 %); `averaging_tolerance` bounds the difference between the full and the
first-half running mean of the averaging window.
Convergence.title: Convergence

DesignAdvice.description:
Adjoint sensitivity on a finished steady solution, and optional shape morphing.

Both are experimental. Morphing runs only when design boxes are also set. Neither
result is a validated design change.
DesignAdvice.title: DesignAdvice

Environment.description: Ground plane under the model (bottom domain face). 'none' keeps the v1 far field.
Environment.title: Environment

PorousZone.description: Heat-exchanger-like resistance from two measured (velocity m/s, pressure drop Pa) points.
PorousZone.title: PorousZone

RotatingZone.description: An additional MRF zone. The legacy `rotation` block remains the zone named 'rotor'.
RotatingZone.title: RotatingZone

post.description: Synchronous import (agents, scripts, small files). The browser uses import-jobs.
Durable import on the CAD lane; progress arrives on /api/runs/{id}/events.
Suggest wheels: round, flat parts with a sideways axis touching the ground.
Darcy–Forchheimer coefficients for a two-point radiator curve (for display).

get.description:
Simulation attempts by default; `kinds=all` or a comma list includes job kinds such
as view extraction and CAD import.
A single self-contained HTML file with this run's simulation results: opens offline, read-only.

Residual and load histories read from the solver's own tables (authoritative backfill
for live charts; the SSE stream carries the same row shapes incrementally).

post.description:
Validate a setup and start its pipeline: mesh, review, solve and results package.

Body: {spec, plan?, name?, tags?, acknowledged?}. Review findings (including experimental
physics) must be acknowledged for this exact configuration id, as for guided launches.
